scope: static QA only; browser and mobile device checks are recorded separately

results.detail: All required HTML, CSS, manifest, and service-worker files exist.
title, Apple Web App title, manifest name, and manifest short_name are aligned.
All local links in public HTML pages resolve to existing files.
Free-beta LP links to the app; no local form is present; commerce page states that paid sales are not active.
No prohibited implementation promises found; key limitations are displayed.
Service worker cache includes public pages and core assets; HTML is network-first so public policy and safety updates can reach existing users; no unimplemented push API is claimed by code.
PWA home contains direct links to the LP and FAQ/safety guidance.
Privacy page documents local storage, GitHub Pages, IP logging, and public Issues.
